item.title: 'Trump announced a ceasefire – and there are sirens': northern Israelis push back from the war-torn border
item.description:
The Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire finalized Wednesday is drawing sharp criticism from residents along the northern border, where sirens still wail daily despite Trump's de-escalation announcement. A new Agam Labs survey at Hebrew University, shared with Reuters, shows Likud support in the north collapsing as voters reject Netanyahu's handling of the Lebanon war and Washington's push for a truce.

item.title: Jewish nurse choked on NYC subway as attacker shouts 'Jews are eating kids'
item.description:
A 23-year-old Orthodox Jewish nurse was violently attacked on a Manhattan C train Sunday afternoon by a Bronx woman who allegedly choked her, ripped out her hair and screamed "Jews are eating kids," according to The New York Post. Police identified the suspect as Diana Smith, who faces hate crime charges. The assault occurred as the Israel Day Parade marched along 5th Avenue without Mayor Zohran Mamdani.
